title: Archive manifests of version 3, contract-event runs and locators of versions 1 to 3
generator: packages/crypto/scripts/archive-v3-vectors.py: an independent Python implementation (standard library only) of docs/spec/archive.md's version-3 manifest, contract-event run and locators, reusing archive-vectors.py's and archive-v2-vectors.py's encoders and CIDs, and contract-event-v9.json's election-registry sequence

rules.labels: as archive.json: label32(x) = SHA-256("archive/" + x); a run reference (contract, first, count, label) has cid 01 ‖ codec ‖ 1220 ‖ label32("run/" + label), codec 55 unless stated, and transaction label32("tx/run/" + label)
rules.records: each run's `records` are its events framed as contract-event records (0x0008) under version 9: contract, n = first + i, and the event's fields
rules.full: archive-v2.json's full manifest with 1024 run references for i = 0 .. 1023: contract label32("contract/" + (i mod 4))[:20], first 1000 * floor(i / 4), count 1000, label "full-" + i, sorted by contract, first and CID
rules.max-events: l2ChainId 84532, contract label32("max-events")[:20], first 0, 65,536 events, event i at l2Block and l2Timestamp i with no topics and no data
rules.max-length: l2ChainId 84532, contract label32("max-length")[:20], first 7, 16 events, event i at l2Block i and l2Timestamp 1000 + i with the one topic label32("topic/" + i) and data the byte i repeated, 2^20 times for i < 15 and for i = 15 as many times as brings the encoding to 2^24 bytes (1,048,149)
